answer: A Verified email inbox bound by in-person pickup code with a ninety-day rotation cooldown turns a private channel into public evidence: the verified email inbox answers a fresh challenge, the in-person pickup code is recorded, and a ninety-day rotation cooldown keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so anyone can check that the identity is backed by a real, reachable channel. A ocean out of place triggers the check: the claim is frozen until its channel clears. The orchard keeps the process honest and the sonnet keeps it open, so challengers can always recheck.
